Class UtilizatorService

java.lang.Object
service.UtilizatorService
public class UtilizatorService extends Object

      public UtilizatorService(Repository<Tuple<String,String>, Utilizator> utilizatorRepository, PrietenieService prietenieService)
      Creates a user service backed by the supplied repository.
